record.question: The community nurse is speaking to a group of new mothers as part of a primary prevention program. Which self-care measures would be most helpful as a strategy to decrease the occurrence of mood disorders?
options: Keeping busy, so as not to confront problem areas
record.explanation: Answer D: Verbalizing rather than internalizing feelings. Encouraging people to express feelings and seek support is a reasonable primary-prevention/mental-health-promotion strategy; the other options are avoidance or treatment rather than prevention. Source/context note: No single communication practice prevents all mood disorders; community support and evidence-based care matter. Reference: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/mental-health-strengthening-our-response. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
